description: Read an X-ray. Pass requestId to poll a grade started with sightglass_xray. Pass adId or sitePageId to read the grade itself: scores, findings and fixes, as far as the workspace can see them. A target nobody has graded returns its summary with the grade locked; offer to run sightglass_xray. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

adId.description: Grade this ad together with its landing page, as a funnel.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

requestId.description: A request id from sightglass_xray: returns its status. Pass this instead of a target while a grade is running.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_xray
title: Get X-ray
